en: Black‑and‑white view of a large European cobblestone market square with arcaded Baroque and Renaissance townhouses on the left, a hotel on the right, small market stalls with awnings, horse‑drawn carts, and people in early‑20th‑century clothing. In the center of the square stands an ornate Marian or Holy Trinity column with several statues and a fenced base. Tall decorative streetlamps with hanging flower baskets and a wide open sky dominate the scene.
